comments.body: Also: carrot's declared wait survived a compaction (muster pane compact) - after it, the pane showed 0% context and still 'waiting ... on melon re-checking two review fixes', so muster pane wait --until idle timed out at 300 s on an idle agent.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen 2026-10-28 in a parallel-work round, twice: anvil and carrot (Claude Code workers, helpers of tulip) each declared a wait on their own reviewers with report --waiting, got the reviews back, finished, posted 'slot N done' to the integrator and ended their turns at an empty prompt. muster window then showed each as 'waiting ... on review from elder' / 'on melon re-checking two review fixes' rather than done or idle. Impact: the integrator reads a finished worker as still busy. Check whether a turn that ends after a post should clear a declared wait, or whether the agent re-declared it at the end of its last turn (pane read --turn did not show it).
title: A worker that posted its report and ended its turn still reads waiting on a wait it declared earlier
